title: Rule 4: the five key terms

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, clause A, GID three.
units.explanation: India की territory में mainland और Indian islands दोनों आते हैं; restricted area की permission खुद लेनी है.
units.example: Andaman India है; foreign island सिर्फ पास होने से India नहीं बनता.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, clause B.
units.explanation: Controlling Officer वही है जो Supplementary Rule one ninety one के under declared है.
units.example: Team leader होना enough नहीं; designated officer का record देखो.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, clause C.
units.explanation: Disciplinary Authority का meaning CCS CCA Rules nineteen sixty five, Rule two, clause G से आता है.
units.example: LTC fraud case में सिर्फ bill pass करने वाला officer automatically disciplinary authority नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, clause E.
units.explanation: Town, village या place को employee declare करे और Controlling Officer accept करे, तब hometown है.
units.example: Ravi ने Jaipur लिखा, पर acceptance pending है; declaration अकेला enough नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, clause F.
units.explanation: Shortest direct route का meaning Supplementary Rule thirty और उसके orders से आता है.
units.example: Goa घूमने का detour खुद choose किया, तो पूरा detour automatically reimbursable नहीं.

title: Spouse, children and all three numerical exceptions

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, clause D, Roman one, Note two; FAQ three.
units.explanation: Spouse पर income test नहीं; साथ रहना भी जरूरी नहीं.
units.example: Wife private job में अच्छा earn करती है और Pune रहती है; spouse eligibility फिर भी है.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, clause D, Roman one; FAQ one.
units.explanation: Normally two eldest surviving unmarried dependent children; step और legally adopted children included, residence test नहीं.
units.example: Three unmarried बच्चे हैं; exception नहीं तो youngest को choose करके eldest को replace मत करो.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, clause D, Roman one; FAQ four.
units.explanation: Unmarried dependent child के लिए twenty five years का upper age cut off नहीं.
units.example: Twenty eight year old unmarried dependent daughter eldest two में है; age से reject नहीं होगी.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four D, Explanation one, Roman one.
units.explanation: Twenty October nineteen ninety seven से पहले already more than two children थे, तो numerical exception है.
units.example: Nineteen ninety six में three children थे; सिर्फ two child cap से third reject नहीं होगा.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four D, Explanation one, Roman two.
units.explanation: Restriction start होने के one year के अंदर born children को numerical protection है; fresh yearly window नहीं.
units.example: Third child March nineteen ninety eight में born हुआ; historical window check होगा.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four D, Explanation one, Roman three.
units.explanation: Second childbirth में twins या triplets से total two से बढ़ा, तो exception है.
units.example: First childbirth one baby, second childbirth twins: three children का numerical exception; third childbirth twins automatically नहीं.

title: Wives, daughters, parents and dependency

units.spoken_ref: Rule four D, Explanation two.
units.explanation: Normally one wife; two legally wedded wives और second marriage की specific Government permission हो, तब exception.
units.example: Sirf second marriage certificate enough नहीं; specific Government permission भी चाहिये.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, clause D, Roman two; FAQ one.
units.explanation: Divorced, abandoned, separated या widowed daughter को dependent और साथ रहना दोनों चाहिये.
units.example: Dependent divorced daughter अलग flat में रहती है, तो residence test fail; माँ के लिए rule अलग है.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four D, current Explanation three; FAQ one.
units.explanation: Eligible sister या daughter के बच्चे automatically family नहीं; current Explanation three, old four था.
units.example: Widowed daughter eligible है, पर उसका son सिर्फ grandson होने से covered नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, clause D, Roman three; FAQ three.
units.explanation: Dependent parents, stepmother और stepfather included; साथ रहना जरूरी नहीं. Yeh सिर्फ twenty twenty five का नया change नहीं.
units.example: Dependent mother Kanpur में रहती है, employee Delhi में; eligibility residence से fail नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, Note one; FAQ two; order twenty three September two thousand eight.
units.explanation: Income all sources जोड़ो, pension और temporary increase भी. Limit minimum family pension plus DR; FAQ base nine thousand है.
units.example: Parent की pension, rent और interest जोड़कर applicable limit से compare करो.

title: Income arithmetic, siblings, exclusions and marriage

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, Note one; FAQ two, income ceiling.
units.explanation: Assumed DR fifty percent, current rate नहीं: nine thousand plus forty five hundred equals thirteen thousand five hundred.
units.example: Income thirteen thousand five hundred पर pass; one rupee extra पर income test fail.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, clause D, Roman four; FAQ one, brothers.
units.explanation: Brother unmarried minor हो, साथ रहे, dependent हो; parents dead या खुद employee पर dependent हों.
units.example: Twenty two year old unmarried dependent brother को minor brother category से LTC नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, clause D, Roman four; FAQ one, sisters.
units.explanation: Sister unmarried, divorced, abandoned, separated या widowed हो; साथ और dependent हो; parents dead या dependent. Minor test नहीं.
units.example: Thirty year old unmarried sister सारी conditions meet करे तो age से reject नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four D; FAQ five and FAQ one, exclusions.
units.explanation: Parents in law, grandparents और unlisted relations सिर्फ dependent होने से family नहीं बनते.
units.example: Mother in law साथ रहती और dependent है; employee की own mother वाली category use नहीं होगी.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, GID one, Note three; order two April nineteen sixty five.
units.explanation: Female employee hometown LTC पर गयी, वहीं शादी हुई; new husband का hometown से HQ leg allow हो सकता है.
units.example: Neha Jaipur में शादी करती है; husband Jaipur से उसके Delhi HQ आता है.

title: All operative Rule 4 Task Force clauses and away family

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, GID two, clause Roman one.
units.explanation: LTC advance Head of Office sanction कर सकता है; सिर्फ Controlling Officer तक authority limited नहीं.
units.example: Employee advance file Head of Office के पास भेजता है; amount और settlement checks फिर भी लगेंगे.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, GID two, clause Roman two.
units.explanation: Shortest route accident या दूसरे cause से disrupted हो, Controlling Authority actual route reimbursement approve कर सकती है.
units.example: Flood से route बंद है; alternate route का proof और approval लो, personal detour मत जोड़ो.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, GID two, clause Roman six; Note four.
units.explanation: Leave preparatory to retirement में eligible LTC दोनों ways है; return leave expire होने से पहले complete करो.
units.example: LPR thirty September end होती है; twenty nine को return okay, two October return condition fail.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, GID four, Note five Roman one; FAQ eight.
units.explanation: Away spouse और dependent children residence से travel कर सकते हैं; ordinary case में actual या HQ destination ceiling, जो कम.
units.example: Actual eligible fare four thousand, HQ ceiling six thousand: reimbursement four thousand, extra two thousand नहीं.

units.spoken_ref: Rule four, Note five Roman two; FAQ seventy five; order thirty one October twenty seventeen.
units.explanation: Family residence से HQ और back आए तो full entitled reimbursement; HQ to HQ zero ceiling मत लगाओ. Valid All India occasion चाहिये.
units.example: Pune family Mumbai HQ आती और Pune लौटती है; valid All India LTC पर entitled fare check होगा.

title: Counting HT/AI, separate travel and private spouse

units.spoken_ref: FAQ seventy four, family at headquarters.
units.explanation: Family HQ पर हो: hometown option पर hometown trip HT; All India option में hometown भी choose कर सकते हो.
units.example: Delhi से Patna, accepted hometown है; valid All India option declared हो तो counting All India होगी.

units.spoken_ref: FAQ seventy five, family away from headquarters.
units.explanation: Away family की HT claim पर lesser ceiling; All India destination HQ या hometown भी हो सकता है, normal fare limits के साथ.
units.example: Kanpur family Patna HT जाये: eligible actual three thousand versus HQ ceiling five thousand, claim three thousand.

units.spoken_ref: FAQ six; Rule nine.
units.explanation: Different groups, times और destinations allowed; relevant block और available occasion फिर भी check करो.
units.example: Employee May में Goa, eligible spouse June में Kochi जाये; separate travel से extra block नहीं बनता.

units.spoken_ref: FAQ seven; Rule nine.
units.explanation: Same two year sub block में कुछ members HT और कुछ All India use कर सकते हैं.
units.example: Eligible spouse HT Jaipur, employee All India Goa choose करे; individual occasion record clear रखो.

units.spoken_ref: FAQ nine, private sector spouse.
units.explanation: Private job वाला spouse अपने employer का LTA ले सकता है; blanket ban नहीं.
units.example: Wife employer से LTA लेती है; husband की Government LTC सिर्फ इसी वजह से automatically barred नहीं.

title: Child fares and family during study/training

units.spoken_ref: FAQ ten; order sixteen May twenty eighteen.
units.explanation: Under five child की separate train seat या berth का paid fare LTC में reimburse नहीं.
units.example: Four year old के लिए extra berth खरीदी; payment proof alone reimbursement नहीं बनाता.

units.spoken_ref: FAQ eleven; order sixteen May twenty eighteen, air restriction.
units.explanation: Non air entitled employee के under five child का airfare ordinary route पर नहीं; allowed Special Dispensation air segments exception हैं.
units.example: Airline full fare लेती है, फिर भी ordinary case में no; scheme segment की valid permission अलग check करो.

units.spoken_ref: FAQ eleven; order twenty nine April twenty sixteen, rail fare.
units.explanation: Five से under twelve child का actual paid rail fare eligible entitlement के अंदर reimburse होता है.
units.example: Eight year old की permitted rail berth का actual fare paid है; automatically half fare cut मत करो.

units.spoken_ref: Rule seven, GID seventeen, clauses A, B Roman one and B Roman two.
units.explanation: Study leave पर self और साथ वाली family का fare actual या normal HQ ceiling, जो कम; बाकी family normal terms पर.
units.example: Chennai HQ, Pune study, Goa destination: actual eight thousand, HQ ceiling six thousand; self और साथ family पर six thousand ceiling.

units.spoken_ref: Rule seven, GID twenty, clause Roman three, overseas training comparison.
units.explanation: Overseas training से foreign flight LTC में automatically funded नहीं; Indian HQ या SR fifty nine HQ ceiling relevant है.
